The Prison of the Bereft was a location found on the Hub Island while Aura was in office. It was a metal cage where players were sent to for a duration of 5 minutes for committing various offenses.

Game Message

[edit | edit source]

When a player was sent to prison, a message appeared for everyone in the lobby:

JAILED! <player> has been sent to jail!

Players were sent into the cage by doing one of the following:

  • Punching a Goon
  • Using the /killaura command
  • Sending "Aura Sucks", "Aura Bad", "Screw Aura", or similar in the chat (includes profanity)

When sent to the Prison of the Bereft, the following text displayed:

INSOLENT!
You have been sent to jail for 5m.

While in prison, the player couldn't warp anywhere and the /killaura command was disabled. Additionally, throwing  Ender Pearls and summoning Pets were disabled.

Prison Break

[edit | edit source]

After the first Minister Election ended, 7[YOUTUBE] im_a_squid_kid was placed in jail instead of becoming Minister. A Corrupt Goon appeared in the basement of the  Hexatorum to sell a  Rusty Spoon that could be used to participate in breaking the cage. Once the Prison of the Bereft was broken, players could no longer be jailed.

Prison Reconstruction

[edit | edit source]

At the end of the second Minister Election, the Prison of the Bereft was repaired. It swapped from wood to metal and placed 3 Guard Goons and a Judicial Goon around it. This allowed players to be jailed again; in addition, 4[MVP] Confused_Goon was placed in the jail.

Following the eighth Minister Election, SnowflakeKiwi was imprisoned for attempting to remove the Work Smarter perk.

At the ninth and last Minister Election, all methods to be imprisoned were disabled.

Following Aura's leave from office, the Prison of the Bereft was removed.

Trivia

[edit | edit source]
  • Once Aura was elected, a Goon was seen building the cage block by block until completion.
  • If a player attempted any of the actions that sent them to jail again while their sentence wasn't over, they were sent back to jail and the timer reset.
  • It was possible to escape the Prison of the Bereft in multiple ways, such as using an  Ender Pearl or  Horse Pet/ Skeleton Horse Pet. However, the game still classified the player as imprisoned. If the player warped away from the Hub Island, they were sent back shortly after.
  • Ministers that betrayed Aura were imprisoned for the duration of their term.
  • While Aura and her Goons were present on the Alpha Hypixel Network, the Prison of the Bereft was not.
  • Bereft means 'lacking in something'.
